statement: Write a PRD for a one-page website for Brew Lab, a small specialty coffee shop in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, where visitors see the menu with prices, opening hours and location, and can pre-order a coffee for pickup.
users: Coffee lovers and office staff nearby.
problem: People cannot see the menu or order ahead.
features: Pre-order form (name, phone, items, pickup time; order emailed to hello@brewlab.example)

user_groups.name: Coffee lovers
actions: See opening hours and where to find the shop

user_groups.name: Office staff nearby
actions: See opening hours and where to find the shop

constraints: No online payment; customers pay at pickup
facts: Monday to Saturday 7:30 am to 9:00 pm
name, phone, items and pickup time
No online payment, they pay at pickup
standards: The PRD is a markdown document with the sections Problem, Users, Goals, Requirements, Success metrics and Out of scope
Nothing is invented beyond the brief
rules: Design documents are written in the order PRD, HLD, LLD, each from the one before
The final website is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file
